decode_policy: Full complete official MP3 decode, one audio stream, CPU flags0, single thread, bitexact flags; decode native float stdout separately for hash/frame count. Mono16k PCM16 via FFmpeg swr with no dither. No -ss/-t/trim/tempo/rate-pitch manipulation, denoise, gain, normalization, silence removal or internal gaps.
duration_gate: Decoded16k sample duration must equal full native decoded frame duration within one16k sample. Original mediaSHA/size must match pinned LFS object. Metadata durations are descriptive, not truncation limits.
frontend_policy: Existing continuous_wav_features: one persistent MicroFrontend per whole recording,10s I/O blocks, exactly one final <=159-sample zero pad. uint16 frames x40; no wake detector, thresholds or model inference.
mechanical_policy: All12 files mandatory; authenticate every pointer/transcript/metadata before raw media decode. Original transcript exact target-alias text scan must be empty or readiness stops with all sources retained. No retry/replacement/subset or score-based exclusion. Preserve partial output/errors.
publication_policy: No raw media, decoded waveform, native decoded samples or derived frontend payload redistribution: upstream license explicitly covers transcripts/text only. Publish scripts, attributable source metadata, hashes and upstream URLs. Runtime/PCM hashes must be compared before any cross-machine same-PCM claim.
score_policy: No wake-model scoring in this stage. A separate frozen profile/threshold/baseline/event/FAR protocol is required before first inference. Development only, never training/final.
limits: Country by Ticker is company metadata, not certified speaker country/accent. Physical speakers can recur across calls and source/pretraining overlap is unknown.
Original transcript screening is incomplete evidence: omitted/mistranscribed targets can remain. No ASR/model scoring used for selection.
Financial calls are domain-limited; pauses, music and operator announcements remain. Not household-noise or Mandarin coverage.
At least12whole recording clusters, not independent utterances or a general population. Nominal Poisson bounds do not account for clustering.

Audio is gapless-decoded compressed source: preserve full decoded logical audio, not claim bit-identical to an unavailable pre-MP3 master. Mono mixing and rational sample-rate conversion are declared transforms.
Runtime/model/frontend identity and exact decoded PCM must be verified before future same-input comparisons; ffmpeg bitexact flags alone do not prove cross-platform equality.
New development exposure does not rescue failed old gates or authorize candidate promotion. All three existing final sets remain untouched.
No playback, microphone, firmware/OTA, audio-producer/AEC/AGC/FIFO change or dining-room production-board operation.
